finding.headline: "The Omugwo WhatsApp War"
finding.problem: "Mama is offended if I don't buy what she lists. But I live in a one-bedroom flat in Manchester. I can't explain to her that half this stuff won't fit or isn't safe here. I'm caught between respect and reason."
finding.person: Diaspora mum whose Nigerian mother/in-law sends daily voice notes dictating purchases ("buy the wooden cradle, buy 50 onesies") while her local midwife says minimal.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (cultural mediation chapter) / Angle for A1.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
